# NNNN. Short imperative title

## Context

The problem, the forces at play, and any constraints. Write for a developer who wasn't there.

## Decision

What was decided, stated as a rule ("Core never imports plugin code."). For a proposed record, write
"Undecided." and list the open questions.

## Alternatives considered

- **Alternative**: why it was rejected. If nothing else was considered, say so.

## Consequences

What this makes easier, what it makes harder, and what must now be true elsewhere in the codebase.
